thread:
deploy-bot: deploy v2.14 phased fanout -> 10% eu-west1 started, warmup probes scheduled.
maya: quick FYI — seeing synthetic-heartbeat gaps in eu-west1, p95 latency from probes jumped ~120ms, ~5% probe failures in the last 2m.
sam: checked logs, prefill KV miss rate spiked on s-eu-03 hosts during ramp, a few hosts showing cold caches.
iris: suggestion: pause ramp at 10% and let prefill finish. prefer hold vs immediate rollback.
nate: +1 to pause. Also recommend bumping prefill concurrency for this bucket: `./scripts/prefill --concurrency 8 --route embed-route`.
deploy-bot: synth-run #789 queued (target=100). current status: 0/100 complete. will post updates.
maya: if we hold, we should consider pinning latency-sensitive traffic away from v2.14 (embed-route) to avoid user-facing regressions.
sam: we can set an edge route pin quickly: `routepin set embed-route v2.13-compat --duration 10m` — this will take ~30s to propagate.
iris: also suggest temporarily increasing the synthetic probe timeout to 3s during warmup so slow cold starts don't count as failures.
nate: started the prefill command, re-running warmup now. will watch probe pass-rate; threshold for rollback = >3% failures sustained.
deploy-bot: synth-run #789 update: 7/100 failed (errors: 503 timeout, kv-miss) — tracking.
maya: thanks — I'll patch release notes with a hold advisory and the mitigation steps so SRE/customer-success have something to reference.
sam: route-pin applied. edge confirms pin to v2.13-compat for embed-route.
maya: :thumbsup: prefill seems to be reducing misses, p95 dropping.
deploy-bot: synth-run #789 second update: 3/100 failed after prefill tweak, latency trending down. Rollout remains paused at 10% (manual hold).
iris: keep this thread open for 20m sign-off; if fail-rate stays <2% for 20m we resume phased fanout.
nate: agreed. I'll keep an eye on s-eu-03 hosts and restart any warmstart containers if misbehaving.
maya: if anything spikes, we'll rollback to 0% and reopen a hotpatch thread. for now, monitoring.
deploy-bot: noted. Auto-resume policy suspended; will resume if synthetic failures remain <2% for 20m or on manual resume.
notes: manual hold at 10% due to prefill/KV warmup; route pinned for embed-route; prefill concurrency increased; synth-run #789 used as gating.
